component.name: Sticky Notes
component.summary: Short notes, colour-coded, docked against the screen edge

description.p: Sticky Notes keeps each note as a colour-coded tab stacked against the edge of the screen. A tab slides its note out when you point at it and opens it in a small window when you click it.
Notes are stored in a private SQLite database in your own data directory. Completing a note is a state it keeps, and deleting one puts it in a trash you can undo from for thirty days.
